rationale: Strict full-import radar and vacuum-route reference validation already exists in v1.81.0 and can strand a structurally valid plan because an optional device destination was deleted. Shared copy-only recovery also closes the old export/import validation gap, without modifying live stores or relaxing normal Save and ZIP security.

summary.ru: Восстановление бэкапов с устаревшими связями устройств и проверка экспортируемой копии с понятным отчётом об исправлениях.
summary.en: Recover backups with stale device links and validate exported copies with a clear repair report.
